_comment: How to read each metadata sheet into data/specimens.csv. Run: python scripts/import_metadata.py. Columns not listed under 'columns' are recognised by name (testing date -> test_date, weight -> mass_g, ...) or become parameters under their own name; map a column to null to drop it. Dates are read month-first (MDY) unless date_order says DMY.
_bulk_density_comment: Solid PLA density. With a measured mass column (weight / mass_g), relative density is computed per specimen from it instead of the 0.8 default.

sources.name: plain
sources._raw_comment: Raw exports in data/raw/plain/. The first number group in '..._<test no>_<export>.csv' is matched to 'test no'.
sources._split_comment: Pattern code 'abc' -> one numeric parameter per digit. Rename these to what the digits mean.
